project.name: osgi/boot/boot-discovery
project.description: The embedded-OSGi boot MODEL, shared by the prod executor (osgi/runtime) and the test-world FelixFrameworkExtension so both agree on the boot topology instead of re-implementing it. Declares the embed capability namespace bundles self-mark with, the BootStackJar registry of the third-party boot stack (pax-logging, felix.scr/resolver — not ours, so named not scanned), and ClasspathBundleIndex: an instance that scans java.class.path ONCE and answers locate / embeddable-bundles / mirror-imports queries. Depends only on the JDK jar/manifest API — NO felix, NO pax — so a consumer that only needs to FIND bundles never drags the boot runtime's closure (notably pax-logging-api, a second org.slf4j provider) onto its classpath.
